scope: Focused checks for eight integrations; not a complete functional or gameplay suite.

fixtures.fabric_pinned: AdditionZ 1.3.2; BetterEnd 4.0.11; ExtendedDrawersAddon 1.0.2; Runes 0.9.13; SmitherZ 1.0.4; Graveyard 3.1; TieredZ 1.3.3
fixtures.fabric_variant: Graveyard 4.0.1 and Runes 1.3.2 narrow layout smoke

checks.name: Layouts and bounds
checks.detail: Fabric seven-mod entries, survival and creative drawer sizes, all three gear tab pairs; Forge Graveyard, Runes and Deep Aether. Native template layout errors empty. Graveyard storage and End furnace use Core built-ins.

checks.name: Gravestone exclusion
checks.detail: Both loaders remained native GravestoneScreen without a hosted window.

checks.name: Storage conservation
checks.detail: Fabric and Forge urn, small urn, coffin and sarcophagus each passed server pickup, return and reopen persistence: 16 checks per loader.

checks.name: Drawer utility and lifetime
checks.detail: Player lock item insertion and removal changed authoritative locked flag and returned the item; source removal closed window.

checks.name: Ossuary recipe
checks.detail: Forge recipe selection and pickup consumed one bone block and placed one bone remains on cursor.

checks.name: Rune recipe
checks.detail: Forge Runes 1.3.2: one cobblestone and one amethyst shard produced eight arcane stones.

checks.name: BetterEnd smelter
checks.detail: Real terminite recipe consumed iron, ender dust and fuel; output picked up. Recipe book opened/closed and placed raw iron from player inventory.

checks.name: Combiner
checks.detail: Three each of three ingredients produced three antidotes, picked up from result; book opened/closed and placed three ingredients. Processing used previous isolated run; final run verified compact template and recipe placement.

checks.name: Gear menus
checks.detail: Three paired tab transitions both directions; reforge consumed diamond and amethyst shard; rename output and full cost; normal smithing and grindstone results; linking conserved socketed sword on close; unlink produced unsocketed sword and consumed extraction hammer.

checks.name: Fletching
checks.detail: One flint, stick and feather consumed for six arrows.

checks.name: Chunk Loader
checks.detail: Fuel consumed; contiguous iron/gold upgrades enabled loading; grid click changed ChunkList [4] to [4,0]; source removal closed window.

checks.name: Newer Fabric versions
checks.detail: Graveyard 4.0.1 and Runes 1.3.2 layout, movement and bounds smoke only.

limitations: No complete functional or gameplay suite was requested or run.

Fabric pinned interactions and variant checks used the staged JAR hashes listed above under Fabric Loader 0.19.5. Entry-by-entry comparison with the final distribution found variant classes/resources identical except fabric.mod.json minimum loader and MANIFEST provenance; pinned run03 also differs in DeepAetherNativeUi.class, whose changed alias is Forge-only. Detailed comparison: build/project-everything-eight-mockups/tested-artifact-content-comparison.json.

Forge tests used a named development runtime with SRG-to-named remapped copies of packaged JARs. An embedded Runes BundleAPI invoker required a QA-only named mapping adjustment. Hashes and transformations are recorded in forge-remap-lineage.json and runes-nested-named-lineage.json in the Forge run directory. This is not retail-launch certification.
Smither unlink extraction is randomized; this attempt returned an unsocketed sword but did not yield a separate surviving gem.
Other mod versions, upgrade combinations, dedicated servers and unrelated features were not comprehensively tested.
